purpose: Resolve discrete core-gradient and boundary-response artifacts before physical core admission; two additional prescribed static fields only

geometry.meaning: 2W prescribed static rectangle, not an accepted propagation domain

support_policy: New analytic vacuum and direct causal roots; no archived interpolant extrapolation, no seed acceleration outside its box

small.meaning: Below previous catalogue support; raw Cartesian gradients fixed

normal.meaning: Exact normal point, no amplitude finite difference

high_gradient.meaning: Potential negative-symbol control; sign is a result, not time evolution

comparisons.gradients: Compare sampled GLL derivatives, analytic input derivatives, center Gamma and center D36; a coarse negative discrete symbol is not alone physical failure of the prescribed profile
comparisons.core: delta .05 at8x4 diagnoses previous coarse-center sign; delta .1 at16x8 extends4x2/8x4 convergence
comparisons.boundaries: Keep all four boundary values fixed by conjugate reaction loads for instantaneous response; no device boundary admission
comparisons.force: Report mass-weighted volume-force norms and separate boundary reactions; no repeated global finite differences
comparisons.current: Sum oriented graph-edge currents across x sections; individual edge current is not section current
comparisons.mobility: Reuse expensive spectra/forces for all three time pairs, unconstrained history and fixed-boundary control
comparisons.physical_reference: Independent spatial physical reference D.4.4 and coupled weak transient remain pending after these two diagnostics

execution.eta: within section plus prior task average
execution.cost_basis: Prior561-node case518s;2145-node case estimated by spectral query growth with added dense-matrix cost. Estimate, not guarantee.
